description: `loadAndSet()` runs a `?{}` query — so it escalates to the server per §12 — and then assigns to the reactive cell `@count`. Per §12.2 a server function cannot write client-reactive state, so E-RI-002 fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §12.2 — reactive state is CLIENT-side. A function that touches a server resource auto-escalates to the server (§12), and a server function has no client-reactive referent to write: the assignment would compile to a store update on a process that holds no store. Rejecting it is what keeps the inferred split honest — the alternative is a write that silently does nothing on the tier it actually runs on. §51.0.E (`server=@source`) and §38.4 (a channel cell) are the sanctioned ways to move server-owned values to the client.
